title: A pesar de: results and limits

sections.content: You know *a pesar de* + noun or infinitive and *a pesar de que* + a full clause from B1 Unit 32. They admit a difficulty and go on. They are the right tool for the balance of industrialisation: real achievements, but also real limits.

items.spanish: A pesar de estos logros, la región tenía problemas.
items.english: Despite these achievements, the region had problems.

items.spanish: A pesar de que el Estado ayudaba a la industria, las exportaciones seguían siendo materias primas.
items.english: Although the state helped industry, exports were still mostly raw materials.

items.spanish: A pesar del crecimiento de las ciudades, la desigualdad entre regiones no desapareció.
items.english: Despite the growth of the cities, the inequality between regions did not disappear.

items.spanish: A pesar de ser pequeño, el mercado interno permitió crecer a muchas fábricas.
items.english: Although it was small, the home market let many factories grow.

sections.content: After *a pesar de* put a noun or an infinitive (*a pesar de los límites*, *a pesar de ser pequeño*). Before a full verb use *a pesar de que* (*a pesar de que ayudaba*). Remember *de* + *el* = *del*: *a pesar del crecimiento*.
